summary.headline: Mastery of the Native
summary.text: Astrological judgments on the native’s power, kingdom, status, and leisure through the planet applying to the ascendant lord, its exaltation, house, term, triplicity, or face, and through the part of work and its lord. The page then opens Chapter 33, “On the mastery of the native.”
